2609.25607.title: ArticleMiner: Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction from Scientific Publications
2609.25607.paper_summary: Scientific papers keep much of their quantitative content in tables and supplementary files, where a number means something only through its header, caption, unit, analytical method, and the conventions of its field. Recovering the rows and columns of a table is therefore not the same as recovering the scientific fact it reports. Most semantic table-interpretation methods assume that a clean table is already available and subsequently map its cells or columns to ontology terms, whereas most publication-level extraction systems are designed for a single domain. We study a middle path: a shared process that reads a paper and its supplementary files, gathers evidence from several parsers and a language model, and reconciles that evidence, while a bounded human-authored task module for each task supplies the domain meaning. The module lists the canonical names the graph may use, the surface forms that map to them, a small set of derivation rules and validity constraints, an identity key, and the bindings used to write RDF. It defines what a task is allowed to emit; it does not try to list every convention of a field. We build four such modules (for drug-discovery chemistry, materials science, machine learning, and mineral geochemistry) in the ArticleMiner framework, and evaluate them on 163 papers, including a new geochemistry benchmark with expert-curated ground truth. In comparisons against a same-LLM few-shot baseline, the point estimates favor ArticleMiner on all four tasks, with uncertainty on the two smaller benchmarks. The geochemistry comparison also includes access to supplementary files, so its improvement cannot be attributed to domain guidance alone.
2609.25607.paper_summary_zh: 科學論文將其定量內容大部分保留在表格和補充檔案中，其中數字的意義僅通過其標題、說明、單位、分析方法及其領域的慣例來理解。恢復表格的行和列因此並不等同於恢復其報告的科學事實。大多數語義表格解釋方法假設已經有一個乾淨的表格可用，然後將其單元格或列映射到本體術語，而大多數出版級提取系統則是針對單一領域設計的。我們研究了一條中間道路：一個共享過程，該過程閱讀論文及其補充檔案，從幾個解析器和語言模型中收集證據，並調和這些證據，同時每個任務的有界人類編寫任務模塊提供領域意義。該模塊列出了圖形可以使用的標準名稱、映射到它們的表面形式、一小組推導規則和有效性約束、一個身份鍵，以及用於編寫RDF的綁定。它定義了任務被允許發出的內容；它不試圖列出一個領域的每個慣例。我們在ArticleMiner框架中構建了四個這樣的模塊（針對藥物發現化學、材料科學、機器學習和礦物地球化學），並在163篇論文上進行評估，包括一個由專家策劃的地球化學基準的新基準。在與同一LLM的少量樣本基線進行比較時，所有四個任務的點估計均偏向ArticleMiner，對於兩個較小的基準則存在不確定性。地球化學的比較還包括對補充檔案的訪問，因此其改進不能僅歸因於領域指導。
